title: SpaceXAI Launches Grok 4.5 for High-Efficiency Agent Workflows
summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5, targeting agentic software engineering and high token efficiency across complex developer tasks.
content:
SpaceXAI officially launched Grok 4.5, its flagship reasoning model for software engineering and complex analytical tasks.

The model features improved token efficiency. It solves programming benchmarks using fewer reasoning steps than previous model versions.

Deep Tool Integration

Grok 4.5 optimizes multi-turn interaction with development environments. It plans multi-file code refactors and executes shell commands with low error rates.

The model integrates with major developer tools, including Cursor, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace add-ins.

Token efficiency allows AI agents to solve complex coding tasks at lower operational costs.

Deployment and API Access

SpaceXAI made Grok 4.5 available via web, mobile applications, and enterprise API endpoints. Developers can select Grok 4.5 in the Grok Build harness.

The model rollout begins immediately for developer tier users and enterprise API customers.

Contributor: Alessandro Linzi
